description: Personalized tutor with memory across sessions — "teach me X, at my pace." Builds a syllabus with a pass rubric per unit, teaches one unit per session: a recall quiz on what's due (date-based spaced repetition), examples matched to your background, and an active-recall check graded against the rubric with confidence tags. Progress and weak spots persist in out/learn/<topic>.md, so sessions resume and re-drill what was missed; fact-sensitive content is verified by web search, not memory. Keyless. Use to learn or study a topic — e.g. "/learn rust ownership", "teach me kubernetes", "quiz me on X", "continue the SQL lessons"; "/learn" alone lists topics in progress. For community buzz use pulse; for choosing between technologies use verdict.
